summary: All seven checklist items pass; two non-blocking findings surfaced: the pending marker is written one round trip too early (before proposal, not before buy), and the consecutive-loss boundary counter includes the trigger trade itself.
findings: Stale pending-marker gap: marker is written before the proposal send rather than before the buy send, leaving a wider unsafe window than useDemoTrading on page refresh between the two round trips. Move the localStorage.setItem call to immediately before ws.send({ buy: ... }) in the proposal message handler.

Consecutive-loss boundary fires at the wrong trade: the guard iterates stateRef.current.transactions after patchState has already prepended the new losing tx, so stopBot fires when the streak length equals maxConsecutiveLosses counting the trigger trade. Add a unit test pinning the exact trade at which each stop condition fires to confirm or correct the intended boundary.
